none: PAS KENT-4A8B00: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of House of Constantine. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, contemporary copy of a nummus or AE4 of the House of Constantine. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse: She wolf left suckling the twins Romulus & Remus, two stars above - for old Rome. Inscription: None. Mint mark: -//[]. Minted in Britain by provenance. Reece period 17. Die axis 6 o'clock. The coin is in fine condition with some wear but most of the edges are broken down with corrosion and there is some surface encrustation especially on the obverse. This coin is likely to date to 330-340AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 62 no. 600 and Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece &…
